column1: # Published metrics for Melampsora larici-populina, transcribed from Table 1 of
# Duplessis et al., G3 2026, doi:10.1093/g3journal/jkag247 ("Assembly metrics of Melampsora
# larici-populina genome version 3"). Reference targets for the validation run.
# HOW TO COMPARE. The v3 haplotypes are Hi-C SCAFFOLDED to 18 scaffolds each; this pipeline
# emits CONTIGS unless Hi-C is supplied. Comparable without scaffolding: assembly_size,
# contigs, gc_pct, busco_complete_pct, busco_duplicated_pct. Not comparable until the Hi-C
# branch runs: scaffolds, scaffold_n50, scaffold_n90, max_scaffold, telomeres, centromeres.
# Their method, for a like-for-like run: hifiasm v0.19.9-r616, Hi-C integration mode, default
# parameters, 25.3 Gb HiFi + 65M Hi-C reads; BUSCO v5 against Basidiomycota; NuclearPhaser for
# phasing. conf/mlp.config matches the hifiasm and BUSCO choices.
# v2 is the PREVIOUS reference (the old collapsed assembly), kept as the floor to beat.
# unphased is the 4.04 Mb of contigs v3 could not assign to a haplotype; it is not a target.
